stories.title: ICGS 'Samudra Pratap' dedicated to the nation (Jan 5)
stories.body: India's first indigenous pollution-control vessel, built by Goa Shipyard Limited.

stories.title: CSIR-NPL's National Environmental Standard Laboratory inaugurated (Jan 5)
stories.body: Asia's first and the world's second facility for testing and certifying air-pollution monitoring devices (supports the National Clean Air Programme).
